# `delivery_sla`

**Layer:** **synthetic** — generated by `scripts/synth/generate.py` for demonstration. Every answer that reads this table must say so (`V2-SYN-4`). Dates span 2016-09-01 to 2018-10-31.

Daily delivery performance per carrier and state.

**Grain:** carrier x state x day.

## Columns

| Column | Meaning | Unit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `date` | Day. | date |
| `carrier` | correios, jadlog, loggi or total_express. | text |
| `state` | Real customer state code. | text |
| `promised_days` | Promised delivery time. | days |
| `actual_days` | Actual delivery time. | days |
| `sla_breach_flag` | 1 when actual exceeds promised. | 0/1 |
| `freight_cost` | Average freight cost. | BRL |

## Join keys

- `delivery_sla.state = customers.customer_state`

## Caveats

- Real orders carry no carrier, so this table cannot be joined to an order.
